posts.cooked:
Got a first turn mistbound that helped get us going, used Stratosphere on Brambles and had Bee Bot out round 2 and it never died, so Brambles were allowed to sit around to help flip her back from her second side.

I ended up getting enough damage going with Bots that I let the Mongolian Death Worm loop keep Akash trapped on her second side while Take Down and Mist Bound kept her from discarding it.  Reclaim helped pull off three straight rouds of Akash doing nothing but end of turn damage while heroes dealt her 84 damage to end the game.  Got hit by all 4 destruction cards, but was able to keep Assault rifle the first time (shackles and the Legacy ring really hurt though) and had her pretty well under control when the ongoings got wiped.

Lowest HP Hero was Tempest at 18.  Mint.

posts.name: The Burning Stickman
posts.cooked:
Mint, with an opening draw that I can't tell if it was lucky or unlucky. Before I had any kind of ongoing destruction in hand, Akash's first three cards were all Entomb. On the one hand, this meant everyone taking 15 HP of damage by the end of the second round (thanks, environment target). On the other, it meant I didn't have to worry about Entomb popping up unexpectedly for the rest of the game. No Primeval Eruptions, and the ongoing and equipment wipes came out early enough that I didn't have much on the field anyway, so it didn't wreck me.

Con's bunker came out the same round Legacy picked up a Take Down, so I was able to start getting the card draw up and running quick. Expatriette spent the whole time plugging away with her shotgun, while Unity had to wait a couple rounds to get bots out because of the Entombs (even though she started with equipment and Swiftbot in-hand; a bit frustrating, but necessary), but by the time she was ready to roll, boy did she roll with Platform, Bee and Raptor Bots doing their jobs. Nightmist dutifully tossed damage back at Akash and her limbs, and Mistbound her three times, which let me keep drawing from the Bunker. Tempest got his Localized Hurricane out early and ended up with damn near all his cards in hand, Cleansing Downpour showing up just in the nick of time. He was invaluable in cleaning up the Environment targets, especially after the first three kept drawing from the bunker, while Unity played clean-up duty and finished her off with a Shockwave powered by Swift, Stealth and Champion Bots.

Everyone survived, and the Environment only claimed one Rockslide.

Edit: Forgot to add, but this was my first time ever playing Advanced mode.

posts.name: NinjaMonkey
posts.cooked:
Mint.

It was the perfect opening draw for all heroes except maybe Unity. Legacy started with a Bolster Allies, Take Down and Heroic Interception. Tempest started with Reclaim from the Deep. Nightmist started with Mistbound and Astral Premonition (think that's right, lets her discard a card to control the villain deck). Expat started with Assault Rifle, Hair Trigger Reflexes, and 2 RPG Launchers.

I foolishly gave Akash'bhuta a free pass on the first round to get a little setup before I started whittling her down. Paid for it with an out of turn Entomb, followed by back to back Primeval Eruptions. Ouch.

Between Nightmist, Legacy, and Tempest who drew a second Reclaim from the Deep on round 3, Akash got to play exactly 1 additional card. That one additional card was the vines limb (forget the name) which was put there by Nightmist and only damaged a single hero before it was taken down.

The environment was a factor as well. The Ancient Library was the first card out and I used it to fill my hands while drawing out beasts, and the Unforgiving Wasteland. The beasts took down the 7 or so limbs Akash had drawn with those two earlier Primeval Eruptions.

By the end of the game, Unity had out almost all the bots and was slamming Akash for 30+ points a round.

I actually felt sorry for Akash. Maybe she can keep Baron Blade company in the perenial loser's lounge.
